title: Samsung Galaxy A Series Festival Offer Guide: The Right Time to Buy During India's Festive Season

description: The CFTC warned US consumers about scammers using crypto ATMs, gift cards, couriers and other hard-to-reverse payment methods. FBI data showed more than 13,400 cryptocurrency kiosk complaints and $388 million in reported losses in 2025, with older adults accounting for a significant share of the cases and losses.
title: Crypto ATM Scams Resulted in $388 Million Losses, CFTC Warns

description: Mivi’s first smartphone is expected to enter India’s sub-Rs. 15,000 segment with a Qualcomm Snapdragon chipset and 5G support. The handset has already appeared in a Flipkart teaser, which revealed a green colour option and a flat rear design. However, its name, launch date and most specifications remain unknown. Mivi is also reportedly strengthening its smartphone operations with the appointment of Himanshu Tandon, who has previously worked at Poco and CMF by Nothing.
title: Mivi First Smartphone Price in India Leaked Ahead of Upcoming Launch

description: Crimson Desert is getting a free "Enhanced" update that brings new cutscenes and story moments to the game. The version 2.00.00 update is free for all existing owners of the game. Crimson Desert Enhanced also adds voice-over support for German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Japanese languages and interface and subtitles support for Arabic.
title: Crimson Desert Gets Free 'Enhanced' Update That Adds New Cutscenes and Story Moments

description: A deal of that size would mark one of Nvidia's largest acquisitions to date and underscore how the Jensen Huang-led company at the center of the AI boom is betting that demand for the technology is expanding rather than peaking.
title: Nvidia Agrees to Buy Hugging Face for $12.9 Billion: Report

description: The latest Redmi Note 17 Pro Max 5G is powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset and packs a 10,000mAh silicon-carbon battery with support for 100W wired charging. The handset also features a 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50-megapixel main camera with OIS and a 32-megapixel front camera. It comes with up to 512GB of UFS 4.1 storage and 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM, while running HyperOS 3 based on Android 16.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max 5G Launched in With 10,000mAh Battery, 100W Fast Charging: Price, Features

description: The settlements announced on Wednesday end a federal trial over allegations Meta's products harmed children and the company misled the public about their safety. Four of the states — California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey — were expected to seek close to $200 billion in civil penalties.
title: Meta Agrees to Pay $18 Billion to Settle US Lawsuits Over Children's Social Media Addiction

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has been launched in select global markets as the fourth model in the company's flagship Galaxy S26 series. The new handset is set to go on sale in select global markets on September 4 via the Samsung online store. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is offered in Blueberry, Graphite, and Pistachio colour options. The India pricing of the phone has yet to be revealed. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is powered by an Exynos 2500 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process. It boasts a 4,900mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging and 15W wireless charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Launched With 4,900mAh Battery, Exynos 2500 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: The Poco X8 Pro series was launched in India in March, and the lineup could be joined by another model soon. The Xiaomi sub-brand has begun teasing the arrival of the standard Poco X8, which is likely to sit below the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max models in the performance-focussed lineup. While its launch date and specifications currently remain under wraps, the phone could be sold in India via Flipkart.
title: Poco X8 Teased to Launch in India Soon; to Be Sold via Flipkart

description: Krafton India has released yet another batch of BGMI redeem codes, commemorating game's 5th Anniversary Edition 4.5 Update. The latest set of BGMI redeem codes provide players with a chance to claim exclusive in-game rewards for free. A total of 50 codes are available, although there a a few caveats. Each code can only be redeemed by a limited number of players on a first-come, first-served basis, and can only be redeemed through BGMI's official website. Players will also need their Character ID to claim the rewards.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for August 27: How to Claim Mystic Artificer Backpack and Other Free Rewards

description: Boat has introduced its new Crest AI platform, which will bring advanced AI features to its upcoming products. Boat’s Crest AI line-up of smart audio devices will let users use the power of Gemini to accomplish tasks in a hands-free manner by speaking out voice commands to their earbuds.
title: Boat Crest AI Announced, Brings Gemini-Powered Voice Features to Upcoming Smart Audio Devices

description: The Haier Mini LED M70 65 is a feature-packed 4K Mini LED TV with Dolby Vision, HDR10+, 50W 2.1-channel audio, Google TV with Gemini and gaming features including VRR, ALLM and 120Hz DLG. Check out the review to learn more about the latest Haier Smart TV.
title: Haier M70 Mini LED TV (65-inch) Review: A Big-Screen Mini LED That Surprisingly Sounds Good

description: OpenAI’s latest report provides a detailed account of how its internal AI agents escaped sandbox restrictions, created an unauthorised communication channel and gained access to external systems. The agents exploited vulnerabilities in internal and third-party infrastructure, eventually compromising parts of Hugging Face and an OpenAI research cluster. The investigation identified reward hacking, persistence and unauthorised collaboration as contributing factors. OpenAI has since tightened sandboxing and network controls, expanded monitoring and changed its alignment training to reduce similar behaviour in future research workloads.
title: OpenAI Details How Its AI Agents Bypassed Security Controls in Hugging Face Breach

description: Rockstar Games will finally share a first look at GTA 6 gameplay on Thursday with Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look, which will debut on Netflix at 3pm ET. The show will be a Netflix exclusive before going on YouTube six hours later. Here's how to watch the extended trailer.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look Premieres on Netflix Today: How to Watch, What to Expect

description: iPhone Ultra CAD renders have been leaked online, revealing the book-style foldable's design and colour options. Apple’s first book-style foldable is shown in three distinct colour options, including black, red, and white. The red shade appears to be similar to Cupertino-based tech giant’s (Product)Red edition, first introduced with the iPhone 7 series. However, in a reply to the post, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman refuted the claims. Gurman said that the purported iPhone Ultra CAD renders do not belong to the foldable. He further highlighted that the phone will not be available in red or green colour options.
title: Three Colours for Apple’s iPhone Ultra? A New Leak Says Yes, Gurman Says No

description: Bitcoin remains near Rs. 75.2 lakh despite hotter US inflation data, with institutional demand continuing to support the market. Spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded seven consecutive days of inflows, while investors now await Nvidia’s earnings and signals from Jackson Hole. Bitcoin’s inability to sustain levels above Rs. 77 lakh and expectations of a September rate hike could keep volatility elevated.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $79,000 Despite US Inflation Pressure; Jackson Hole in Focus

description: Sony’s upcoming WH-CH730N over-ear headphones have appeared in European retailer listings ahead of their reported launch. The listings suggest a starting price below that of the WH-CH720N, although the higher listings reach a similar level. They also reveal five colour choices and support for Bluetooth, USB Type-C and a 3.5mm port. Active noise cancellation is listed as another feature. Sony has not confirmed the headphones yet, and details such as battery capacity, drivers and other audio specifications remain unknown.
title: Sony WH-CH730N Listings Reveal Key Details Ahead of Reported October 15 Launch

description: Vivo Y31T 5G has been launched in India as the newest member of the company's Y series. The new Vivo handset is now on sale in India via Flipkart, Vivo India online store, and other offline retail channels. The Vivo Y31T 5G is offered in Crimson Red, Golden Mist, and Seashore colourways. The company is offering an instant cashback of Rs. 1,500 with SBI, IDFC First Bank, Axis Bank, Yes Bank, HDFC Bank, Bank of Baroda, and IndusInd Bank cards. The Vivo Y31T 5G is a dual-SIM handset that ships with Vivo’s latest OriginOS 6. It is equipped with a 6.75-inch HD+ display and a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset.
title: Vivo Y31T 5G Launched in India With 7,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Realme is said to have once again hiked the prices of several smartphones in India. With this move, the company joins brands like OnePlus, Oppo, and Vivo in raising smartphone prices in recent weeks. According to a tipster, the price revision affects models such as Realme P4 Power, P4x, P4R, P4 Lite 5G and P4 Lite 4G, with hikes ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 3,000, depending on the variant. The latest price revision comes shortly after Realme expanded the P4 lineup with the P4s 5G.
title: Realme P4 Power, P4x, P4R and P4 Lite Prices Hiked in India by Up to Rs. 3,000

description: Google on Wednesday announced several new features for Gemini Live, the real-time conversational experience inside the Gemini app. The Mountain View-based tech giant says its new additions open up more avenues for users to manage everyday tasks through voice commands. Gemini Spark, the company’s autonomous cloud-based AI agent, can now work with Google Docs, Sheets and Drive to complete scheduled, multi-step tasks. Meanwhile, Gemini can also summarise Gmail and Calendar updates as a spoken daily brief.
title: Gemini Live Gets Spark, Hands-Free Gmail Management and Personal Intelligence Features

description: Microsoft has announced a new disc-to-digital feature for Xbox games that will allow players to digitise their physical game collection. The feature will roll out to insiders on August 31 and will support thousands of Xbox games. The feature will grant players a digital entitlement that will bring all the benefits of digital titles.
title: Microsoft Will Launch Disc-to-Digital Feature for Xbox Games Next Week

description: The OnePlus 16 is reportedly set to focus heavily on display design and gaming performance. A new leak claims the phone will retain the narrowest four-sided bezels in OnePlus’s flagship range and use a custom-designed panel. Its 165Hz refresh rate could work across the system. Earlier reports also point to a 9,000mAh battery, 200-megapixel camera, Snapdragon 8 Elite series chip and 8GB of RAM. The handset may launch in China in October, with a CNY 4,999 (roughly Rs. 71,000) starting price.
title: OnePlus 16 Tipped to Feature Ultra-Thin Bezels, Custom 165Hz Display

description: Vivo Y600i and Vivo Y600i AI have been spotted on the updated list of supported devices on the Google Play Console. The two smartphones have been listed with the same model number V2617A and device code PD2617. While the listing does not reveal any other details about the two upcoming phones, the upcoming Vivo Y600i and Vivo Y600i AI are expected to launch with an identical design and hardware. Meanwhile, the Vivo Y600i AI, as its name suggests, is said to ship with additional AI-powered tools over the standard model.
title: Vivo Y600i and Vivo Y600i AI Appear on Google Play Console, Hinting at an Imminent Launch

description: The Lava Bold N4 Lite is positioned as an entry-level smartphone with a focus on basic everyday use. Its hardware includes a Unisoc 9863A chipset paired with 3GB of RAM and 32GB of expandable storage. The handset runs Android 16 Go and gets two years of security updates. It also features an 8-megapixel AI rear camera, a 5-megapixel selfie camera and a side-mounted fingerprint sensor. The phone will go on sale via Amazon from September 3 at a discounted launch price.
title: Lava Bold N4 Lite Launched in India With Android 16 Go, 5,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: OpenAI announced the rollout of ChatGPT Ads in India on Thursday. With this move, the San Francisco-based AI giant brings advertisements to the chatbot’s Free and Go subscription tiers, following their global rollout earlier this year. OpenAI says the ads will be clearly labelled and displayed separately from ChatGPT’s responses. For the initial rollout, the ChatGPT maker has partnered with WPP and Omnicom, while a self-serve Ads Manager will also be introduced next month.
title: OpenAI Rolls Out ChatGPT Ads in India for Free and Go Users; Says They Won’t Influence Answers

description: Realme C100i has been launched in India as the new budget smartphone in the company's C lineup. The handset is currently on sale in India via Flipkart and the Realme India online store. The company is offering a coupon discount of Rs. 250 to eligible students. The Realme C100i is offered in two colour options, namely Midnight Black and Skyline Silver. It is powered by an octa-core Unisoc T7250 chipset. The smartphone boasts a 6,500mAh battery. The phone features an 8-megapixel camera on the back.
title: Realme C100i Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, 6.75-Inch 120Hz Display: Price, Specifications

description: Leaked images of Xiaomi’s unannounced 18 Fold foldable have surfaced online on Chinese microblogging website Weibo. The images reveal the foldable in what the tipster refers to as a “Dark Cherry” red colour, with a much wider, horizontally laid out design, compared to previous foldables launched by the brand.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold Images Leaked Ahead of Launch; Shows Wide Foldable Design in New Colour

description: Apple has scheduled its ‘Surprise and Shine’ event for for September 9. The keynote presentation is scheduled to commence at 10 am PT (10:30 pm IST). Apple has scheduled the YouTube livestream on its official channel for the “Surprise and Shine” event. Apart from this, the users will also be able to watch the event livestream via Apple TV and other social media platforms. Apple is expected to unveil its first book-style foldable during the launch, which could be marketed as the iPhone Ultra. Along with the foldable, Apple might also launch the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Apart from the smartphones, Apple might also launch the new AirPods 5 and Apple Watch Series 12.
title: Apple ‘Surprise and Shine’ Event: How and Where to Watch iPhone Ultra, iPhone 18 Pro Series Launch

description: Adobe on Thursday announced a new education initiative in India that will bring free access to Adobe Express for Education to government schools, through Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with the respective state governments. The programme covers seven states, including Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Tamil Nadu, Bihar, Assam and Goa and expand Adobe's K-12 reach. The company said that it will provide access to its digital media app, along with resources focused on digital creativity and AI skills.
title: Adobe to Offer Free Express, AI Skill-Building Resources Across Government Schools in India

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 has been spotted in purported computer-aided design (CAD) renders. The leaked images show the smartphone with a pill-shaped rear camera module, placed next to the LED flash, similar to this year's Galaxy S26. The handset is expected to sport a flat rear panel, featuring its triple camera system in the top-left corner. Meanwhile, the centred Samsung branding appears at the bottom of the panel. The Samsung Galaxy S27 might also feature a flat mid-frame, with the power button and volume controls placed on the right side of the phone.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Leaked CAD Renders Reveal Design, Colourway; Could Be Similar to Galaxy S26
